title: clarion-calm
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: ONE original Japanese call-center recruitment HERO image, wide landscape aspect about 1938:811 (2.39:1). This is a new site-referenced creative direction, not a website screenshot or a clone.
Input image 1: actual saved website screenshot of Clarion, https://www.clarionhealth.com/. Study its composition, type hierarchy and imagery treatment. Input image 2: our current call-center image, used ONLY for subject context (headsets, operators, call-center equipment), not its repeated anime arrangement.
Observed reference element: 電話対応している一人の人物と、中央寄せの落ち着いた見出し。安心感と静かな視線誘導。
Direction: Translate Clarion screenshot's calm single-operator full-bleed portrait and CENTERED text hierarchy into a bright original recruitment hero. A Japanese female call-center operator sits behind a monitor on the RIGHT with a natural listening expression and lightweight boom-mic headset. Airy cool-white office background, no medical content. The LEFT-to-CENTER is mostly white, and the exact two-line headline is CENTER-aligned in this quiet region in refined navy Japanese serif, with subcopy directly below. No cards, no brand logos, no CTA rendered. Very calm, expansive, premium photography; distinctly quieter and more centered than other concepts.
Exact ORIGINAL approved copy: small label "CALL CENTER RECRUIT"; headline "声の向こうに、" / "笑顔を届ける。"; subcopy "コールセンターで、仲間と働く。". Use these strings ONLY, plus 電話対応 / 営業 / サポート / チーム if small work labels are needed. Do not copy any text from the attached website screenshot.
Keep call-center theme recognizable: professional communications headsets worn on heads with natural boom microphones, customer-contact workstation/screens with unreadable interface text, desk telephone or call-script papers. All human foreground staff Japanese adults. Natural proportions and coherent anatomy. Photographic concepts must be photographs; illustrative/sculptural concepts must follow their distinct direction.
Palette: mostly white, navy, cobalt blue and pale blue/teal, natural skin tones. The attached site's other brand colors are reference context, not output requirements. Keep bright edges that suit a white page, with no full dark rectangular background.
NO copied company logos, brands, slogans, named people, identity recreation, dates, certifications, customer quotes, salary/benefit promises, numerical claims, header/navigation, website CTA, browser chrome, watermarks or multiple concept thumbnails. No company-specific recruitment conditions. Preserve legibility, avoid cropped lettering or faces. Output exactly one finished opaque hero image, not a full page.
borrowed_visual_element: 電話対応している一人の人物と、中央寄せの落ち着いた見出し。安心感と静かな視線誘導。

visual_inspection.headline: exact and readable
visual_inspection.reference_composition: center-aligned serif copy in calm whitespace, single operator portrait on right
visual_inspection.callcenter: correct headset boom microphone and workstation; background operators
visual_inspection.source_brand: no copied logo, claim, or source copy
